provenance.edition-pin: material-web is a TOKENS-ONLY clone (CLAUDE.md) — there is no live M3 select component to grep for structure or behavior, so every structure/behavior claim here is [R] and every style value is [S] from a token file. PINNED TO tokens/versions/v0_192. OWNER DECISION: every M3 column pins the v0.192 edition, because material-web's own wrappers @use versions/v0_192 — and tokens/_md-comp-{filled,outlined}-select.scss, tokens/_md-comp-menu.scss, tokens/_md-comp-list.scss and tokens/_md-comp-list-item.scss all do exactly that, which matters more here than for any other component because this column borrows from all four. A full mechanical key/value diff of both select files across the two editions (filled 103 vs 107 entries, outlined 101 vs 105) finds ZERO value divergences among the shared keys. `latest` adds text-field-container-height (56px), text-field-caret-color, text-field-error-focus-caret-color and menu-container-surface-tint-layer-color — all four @deprecated on arrival — and expresses the four composite `-type` entries as @mixins. WHAT CHANGES VALUE IN THE SELECT FILES: outlined text-field-focus-outline-width is a hardcoded 2px in versions/v0_192 and md-sys-state-focus-indicator.$thickness = 3px in latest (and that file does not exist in v0.192). THIS COLUMN NOW USES 2px — see style.trigger.border@box-focus, and note the consequence: the outlined variant thickens to 2px on focus while the FILLED variant still thickens to 3px, because filled's 3px comes from a library override in the edition-independent tokens/_md-comp-filled-select.scss, not from the generated token. The two variants now disagree where they used to match. WHAT IS LOST: text-field-container-height 56px (style.trigger.min-height is a declared gap). THE BIGGEST CONSEQUENCE IS NOT IN THE SELECT FILES AT ALL — IT IS IN THE MENU BORROW. versions/v0_192/_md-comp-menu.scss has EIGHT keys (container-color/-elevation/-shadow-color/-shape and four list-item-selected-* entries) against latest's forty-nine. Every list-item interaction token this column borrowed from `latest`'s menu file — hover/focus state layers, disabled label opacity — is gone from the pinned edition's menu. THEY ARE RE-POINTED, NOT DROPPED, to versions/v0_192/_md-comp-list.scss, which carries the identical family under the same names and is what the hand-authored tokens/_md-comp-list-item.scss wrapper actually consumes. Two of those values move: the focus state layer 0.10 -> 0.12 (md-sys-state), and the disabled label opacity 0.38 -> 0.3 (v0.192's list says 0.3 where latest's menu says 0.38). One is lost outright: list-item-between-space 12px is latest-only, so style.option.gap is a declared gap. FINALLY, ONE VALUE MOVES THROUGH THE COLOUR SYSTEM: on-error-container, one of exactly four sys-color roles that differ between the editions — v0.192 says error10 (#410e0b) light where latest says error30 (#8c1d18). That moves status-error-hover.
provenance.filled-and-outlined-are-one-component: The two files share their vocabulary almost line for line — identical text-field-input-text-*, label-text-*, supporting-text-*, error-*, disabled-*, hover-state-layer-* families and an identical menu-* family. They differ in exactly two mechanisms: filled has an active indicator (bottom-only rule), outlined has an outline. That is the structure.indicator axis.
provenance.outlined-select-IS-filled — the finding: _md-comp-outlined-text-field.scss has NO container-color token at all, which is why input's style.root.background@box carries `transparent` for M3. _md-comp-outlined-SELECT.scss DOES have one: `$text-field-container-color: md-sys-color.$surface-container-highest` (confirmed present and identical in versions/v0_192/_md-comp-outlined-select.scss, the pinned edition, and in versions/latest/sass at line 100). So an M3 outlined SELECT has the same container fill as a filled one, and the filled/outlined axis for select moves only the edge mechanism and the corner shape. Direct grep, both editions, both files. style.trigger.background@box is therefore OFF for M3 — the opposite of input.
provenance.the menu tokens are declared and then di: Both select token files carry a menu-* family (md.comp.{filled,outlined}-select.menu.container.*, .menu.divider.*, .menu.list-item.*) — twenty-one keys in versions/v0_192, and material-web's own hand-authored tokens/_md-comp-{filled,outlined}-select.scss then list EVERY one of them under $unsupported-tokens, i.e. the shipped library composes the standalone md-menu component instead of styling the popup from the select's own set. Both readings are used here: the select's own values win where it has them (notably menu-list-item-selected-container-color), and the gaps are filled by a DECLARED CROSS-FILE BORROW. THE BORROW'S SOURCE CHANGED WITH THE v0.192 PIN, and this is the largest re-point in this column. It used to come from versions/latest/sass/_md-comp-menu.scss, which carries a full forty-nine-key set including list-item-{hover,focus,pressed,disabled}-state-layer-* and the list-item label typescale. versions/v0_192/_md-comp-menu.scss has EIGHT keys and none of that. The equivalent family in the pinned edition lives in versions/v0_192/_md-comp-list.scss — list-item-hover-state-layer-{color,opacity}, list-item-focus-state-layer-{color,opacity}, list-item-pressed-state-layer-{color,opacity}, list-item-disabled-label-text-opacity, list-item-leading-space, list-item-trailing-space — under the SAME names, resolving to the same on-surface role, and it is what the hand-authored tokens/_md-comp-list-item.scss wrapper actually consumes (`@use 'versions/v0_192/md-comp-list'`). Two values move with it (focus layer 0.10 -> 0.12, disabled label opacity 0.38 -> 0.3) and one is lost (list-item-between-space).

style.option.gap.note: DECLARED GAP. Was 12px, sourced from list-item-between-space in versions/latest/sass/_md-comp-list.scss. versions/v0_192/_md-comp-list.scss contains the string 'between' ZERO times — the token is a `latest` addition. WHAT THE CONSUMER LOSES: the sourced spacing between an option's leading icon / selected marker and its label. The horizontal padding survives (leading-space / trailing-space 16px, present in both editions — see style.option.padding); only the internal gap is unsourced. Left off rather than back-filled with the 12px, because a borrowed number would be indistinguishable from a sourced one in the render.

style.option.shape.note: no per-item shape token in the menu family (the standalone list has list-item-selected-container-shape, but that belongs to the separate `list` component and its selected colour disagrees with the select's too)

style.option.background@hover.source: versions/v0_192/_md-comp-list.scss 'list-item-hover-state-layer-color' -> md-sys-color.on-surface at 'list-item-hover-state-layer-opacity' -> md-sys-state.hover-state-layer-opacity = 0.08 — a DECLARED CROSS-FILE BORROW, since the select's own menu-list-item-* family names height, label and selected colour but no interaction state. SOURCE RE-POINTED BY THE v0.192 PIN (was versions/latest/sass/_md-comp-menu.scss, whose forty-nine-key set shrinks to eight in v0.192); VALUE UNCHANGED, because hover is 0.08 in both editions and the list file resolves it to the same on-surface role under the same token name. See provenance.the-menu-tokens-declared-and-disowned.
style.option.background@hover.note: expressed as a background-IMAGE so the layer composites OVER a selected option's background-colour instead of replacing it, which is how an M3 state layer actually works

style.option.active.source: versions/v0_192/_md-comp-list.scss 'list-item-focus-state-layer-color' -> md-sys-color.on-surface at 'list-item-focus-state-layer-opacity' -> md-sys-state.focus-state-layer-opacity = 0.12. SOURCE RE-POINTED AND VALUE CHANGED BY THE v0.192 PIN: was versions/latest/sass/_md-comp-menu.scss at 0.10. Now FOUR points heavier than the hover layer rather than two, which makes behavior.pointer-activates-option = false an even sharper distinction for M3. docs/foundations/state-layers.md tabulates 0.12, so the foundations page and this cell now agree.

style.option.focus-visible.note: Doubly off under the v0.192 pin. versions/latest/sass/_md-comp-menu.scss has focus-indicator-color/-thickness/-outline-offset tokens, but (a) they belong to the standalone menu component and neither select file references them, and (b) they do not exist in versions/v0_192/_md-comp-menu.scss at all, which has eight keys and no focus family — nor does the md-sys-state-focus-indicator.scss they resolve through. The option's focus affordance is its state layer (style.option.active), which is what M3 actually specifies here.

style.option.disabled.source: versions/v0_192/_md-comp-list.scss 'list-item-disabled-label-text-opacity': 0.3 — a cross-file borrow; the select's own file has no option-disabled token at all. SOURCE RE-POINTED AND VALUE CHANGED BY THE v0.192 PIN: was 0.38, from versions/latest/sass/_md-comp-menu.scss's list-item-disabled-label-text-opacity. This is a genuine edition divergence inside the list family itself (v0.192 says 0.3, latest says 0.38), not a role change, and it makes M3's disabled option slightly MORE legible than its 0.38 disabled trigger text — an internal inconsistency that belongs to M3, not to this registry. material-web's tokens/_md-comp-list-item.scss re-exports exactly this value as its `disabled-opacity` $new-token, so 0.3 is what the shipped library uses.

style.option.selected.source: menu-list-item-selected-container-color -> md-sys-color.surface-container-highest, from the SELECT's own file, present and identical in versions/v0_192. NOTE the standalone menu says secondary-container for the same token in BOTH editions (versions/v0_192/_md-comp-menu.scss 'list-item-selected-container-color' -> secondary-container is one of that file's eight keys); the select's own file overrides it to a neutral surface tone, and the select's value is the one used. Unaffected by the pin.

style.group.border-top.note: no group concept; M3 divides with the divider element instead

style.separator.source: menu-divider-height 1px + menu-divider-color -> surface-variant. Full width: the select file carries no divider inset token (_md-comp-list.scss's 16px divider-leading/trailing-space belongs to the standalone list).

style.trigger.status@error.source: text-field-error-outline-color / -hover-outline-color / -focus-outline-color; text-field-error-active-indicator-color / -hover-active-indicator-color / -focus-active-indicator-color. The hover entries resolve to on-error-container, NOT error. No caret entry, because the select's caret tokens are @deprecated-and-removed.

style.trigger.status@warning.note: no warning-* token exists in either select file — confirmed by direct grep

style.trigger.status@success.note: no success-* token exists in either select file — confirmed by direct grep
